name: mobile-foundation
description: Stand a mobile project up and keep it honest: toolchain from real doctor output, an architecture baseline proposed against the tree that exists, and an accessibility audit that runs what is runnable and names what it did not establish.

skills.name: a11y-sweep
skills.line: Audit mobile accessibility by running the checks this stack has and naming what source cannot decide. Emits no score and no conformance verdict.

skills.name: arch-baseline
skills.line: Map the architecture this repository actually has, then propose a baseline against it with the cost of each proposal named.

skills.name: env-doctor
skills.line: Report whether this machine can build this repository, from real commands with real exit codes, against the versions the repo pins.

skills.name: release-gate
skills.line: Check what a store will actually reject, from the manifests in this tree, never asserting that a build is signed, compliant or ready.
